lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-intensity circular clusters are arranged in five distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Centroids show increasing inter-blob distance along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical spot columns, creating a geometric grid pattern where the circular blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity highlights on the upper margin to lower-intensity shadows on the lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes attached to the dorsal-anterior head region and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
